article_title: E-cheating Prevention Measures: Detection of Cheating at Online Examinations Using Deep Learning Approach -- A Case Study
citation: Leslie Ching Ow Tiong and HeeJeong Jasmine Lee. (2021). E-cheating Prevention Measures: Detection of Cheating at Online Examinations Using Deep Learning Approach - A Case Study. https://arxiv.org/abs/2101.09841
title: 7wiseup behaviour dataset of 94 student examination records
description: A released dataset for e-cheating research. The article states: "We have designed a new dataset, namely, the 7wiseup behaviour dataset, which consists of 94 student records that were acquired from different end-of-term examinations at Pyeongtaek University in South Korea." Records were collected in Spring semester 2020 from an e-class LMS during mock, mid-term and final-term exams, and each record includes answers, per-question scores, grades, completion time and IP address. Training used mock-exam data split 80:20, with data augmentation adding 60 abnormal-behaviour samples.
requirements: collected via an LMS exam module that logs answers, scores, grades, completion time and IP addresses
constraints: the dataset is imbalanced, which the authors addressed with a data augmentation approach generating additional abnormal-behaviour samples
